name: Spiritual Domination
label: Quest
description: Spiritual Domination: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I see that the inner fire has dwindled. Would you say the spiritual euphoria lasted an hour?
If it's more of the gizzard gum you desire, then more of the gizzards I require. Back to the wastelands, friend. Do not return until you have recovered ten gizzards and two jowls.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do not waste my time, friend. We have nothing to discuss, unless you have recovered the items I have requested.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Perhaps one day I shall be able to isolate the active enzymes of this assay and produce a much more efficient resultant. Unfortunately, you will have to settle for what I am currently able to produce. Return to me should you require more gizzard gum.
